Submit the SMU undergraduate admission application by the chosen deadline (November 1 for Early Action / Early Decision I, January 15 for Regular Decision / Early Decision II).

Two named awards break the automatic rule and require an extra submission: the President's Scholarship (additional essay) and the Nancy Ann and Ray L. Hunt Leadership Scholarship (additional essay and a YouTube video statement).
SMU's application fee is waived, so no fee must be paid to be considered for these scholarships.
new_scholarship.description: Southern Methodist University in Dallas automatically considers every applicant, regardless of citizenship, for its academic merit scholarships when they apply for admission by 1 November (Early Action / Early Decision I) or 15 January (Regular Decision / Early Decision II). International applicants receive merit aid only: SMU states that need-based financial aid is available only for U.S. citizens or permanent U.S. residents. Individual awards range from a flat USD 7,500 per academic year (International Baccalaureate Scholarship) to about 75 percent of tuition and fees (Nancy Ann and Ray L. Hunt Leadership Scholarship) and full tuition and fees plus a housing scholarship (President's Scholarship). Most awards are stackable but the combined total cannot exceed the cost of tuition and fees.
new_scholarship.best_fit: International first-year applicants with a very strong academic record who are applying to a selective private research university in the United States and can demonstrate the high-school curriculum rigor, GPA and, unless they score highly on SAT/ACT writing, standardised test results SMU looks for in its merit pool.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: Open to applicants of any nationality: "All students who apply to SMU, regardless of citizenship, are automatically considered for SMU's generous academic merit scholarships." There is no separate scholarship application. Need-based financial aid is explicitly closed to international students ("Need-based financial aid is available only for U.S. citizens or permanent U.S. residents"). Applicants must be first-year, apply by the 1 November or 15 January deadline to be considered, and satisfy the standard undergraduate admission requirements (transcript, essay, required counsellor recommendation, optional teacher recommendation and resume, optional SAT/ACT). English proficiency scores are required only where the high-school language of instruction is bilingual or not solely English. Several awards are restricted to particular curricula (International Baccalaureate Diploma, Dallas County high schools, North Dallas High School) and to U.S. citizens or permanent residents where need-based aid is involved.
eligibility: Be a first-year (incoming undergraduate) applicant to SMU; the award is not published as open to transfer or graduate applicants

new_scholarship.english_requirement: SMU's published recommended minimums: TOEFL 90 with minimum subscores of 20+ in reading and listening and 24+ in writing and speaking; Duolingo English Test 115; Pearson Test of English (PTE) 60; ACT 6.5 with minimum subscores of 6.5 in reading, listening, writing and speaking. Scores are not required from students who attended a school with an English-based curriculum, or who have an SAT critical reading and writing score of 580+ or an ACT writing score of 25+. The admitted Class of 2028 international profile shows an average TOEFL of 103 and an average IELTS of 7.7.
new_scholarship.selection_notes: There is no separate selection panel and no separate scholarship application: admission itself is the application. SMU describes its review as holistic, weighing "rigor of high school curriculum, GPA, standardized test scores (optional), English proficiency, essay, resume and letters of recommendation." SMU notes that applicants who submit no SAT or ACT scores "will be considered only for artistic scholarship and need-based aid; they will not be considered for scholarships based on academic merit," and that the recommended combined score for academic-merit scholarship consideration is 1380 on the SAT (critical reading and math only) or 29 on the ACT. Notification for the 1 November deadline arrives in early January and for the 15 January deadline by mid-March. No published award weighting, renewal CGPA or first-come-first-served rule was found for this award family.

programme_detail_official.citizenship_residency: No nationality restriction. SMU states explicitly that "All students who apply to SMU, regardless of citizenship, are automatically considered for SMU's generous academic merit scholarships." Residency in the United States during secondary school determines whether an applicant follows the international or the standard admission process. Undocumented and DACA students are not treated as international students.
programme_detail_official.international_eligibility: Fully open on nationality. International students are considered for the same academic merit scholarships as U.S. applicants, but the need-based component is closed to them: "Need-based financial aid is available only for U.S. citizens or permanent U.S. residents." SMU defines an international student as anyone who must hold a visa to live and study in the United States, including holders of L2, H2 and E2 visas.

Hunt Leadership Scholarship (additional essay and a YouTube video statement). SMU states the undergraduate application fee is waived, so no application or processing fee must be paid to be considered. SMU's financial-aid route through the FAFSA and the CSS Profile applies to need-based and SMU-funded opportunity awards, which international students cannot access; the CSS Profile is separately charged at $25 by the College Board.

programme_detail_official.description: Southern Methodist University in Dallas, Texas automatically considers every applicant, regardless of citizenship, for its academic merit scholarships as part of the undergraduate admission application; SMU states there is no separate application process. International applicants are eligible on the same nationality basis as everyone else, but need-based financial aid is closed to them and is available only to U.S. citizens and permanent U.S. residents. The merit family comprises the President's Scholarship (full tuition and fees, one study abroad experience, and a housing scholarship for on-campus students), the Nancy Ann and Ray L. Hunt Leadership Scholarship (about 75 percent of tuition and fees plus a study abroad experience), the Provost, SMU Distinguished, Second Century and University Scholarships (partial or full tuition), the International Baccalaureate Scholarship (USD 7,500 per academic year), the Dallas County Promise Scholarship, the Mustang Scholarship and the Robert H. Dedman SMU Scholarship. Most awards are stackable but the combined total cannot exceed the cost of tuition and fees, so none of them is a complete cost-of-study package.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Merit tuition assistance only, capped at the cost of tuition and fees. Named award values range from USD 7,500 per academic year to full tuition and fees. Room and board is covered only under the President's Scholarship housing scholarship for on-campus students, and only that award plus the Mustang and Dedman awards include housing. Living expenses, travel, visa and I-20 issuance costs, insurance and health costs are not covered by any of these awards.

application_readiness_checklist: File the SMU undergraduate admission application by 1 November 2026 (Early Action / Early Decision I) or 15 January 2027 (Regular Decision / Early Decision II); there is no separate scholarship form to file
Get the required counsellor recommendation in hand before you submit, because it is the one recommendation SMU marks required
Submit SAT or ACT scores if you want to be considered for academic-merit scholarships - SMU states that applicants with no test scores are considered only for artistic scholarship and need-based aid
Aim for the published merit benchmark of SAT 1380 (critical reading and math) or ACT 29 if your test scores are the weaker part of your file
Have TOEFL, IELTS, DET or PTE results ready if your secondary school's language of instruction is bilingual or not solely English, or if you cannot claim the SAT 580+ / ACT 25+ writing waiver
Do not spend money on a CSS Profile or FAFSA - SMU need-based aid is closed to international students and none of the merit awards depends on those forms
Draft the extra President's Scholarship essay, or the Hunt Leadership essay plus a YouTube video statement, well ahead of the 1 November deadline if you are targeting those two awards
Budget for the costs these awards do not touch: on-campus housing, food, books, health insurance, airfare, visa and I-20 issuance fees
Check whether your own high school is inside or outside Dallas County before chasing the Mustang, Dedman or Dallas County Promise awards, which are geography-restricted
common_rejection_risks: Missing the scholarship-consideration deadline - 15 January is the stated priority deadline for merit scholarship consideration, and later applications are considered for admission only if space is available
Submitting no SAT or ACT scores, which removes you from academic-merit scholarship consideration entirely
Not knowing that need-based aid is unavailable to international students and applying for financial aid that does not exist for you
Omitting the additional essay or YouTube video statement for the President's or Hunt Leadership Scholarships and so being considered only for the automatic pool
Treating stackable awards as a guaranteed full package; SMU caps the combined total at tuition and fees
Overlooking that the Mustang, Robert H. Dedman and Dallas County Promise awards are restricted to specific local high schools
Missing English proficiency documentation where the school's language of instruction is not solely English
Failing to secure the required counsellor recommendation
